content: This 14GB box: ONE verilator build at a time (-j 1); all cells/builds/artifacts under /var/tmp/r1work (NEVER /tmp, RAM tmpfs wiped 3 builds + 2 cells). Long builds: setsid bash -c '...' < /dev/null & disown or tmux new-session -d. pgrep -f matches your own shell - check binaries by ls. RTL edits: commit FIRST (uncommitted tree = void results).

Load-bearing files must be TRACKED, not just cited. Session audit 2026-08-14 (Steve): RTL-ARC.md (the verification contract, cited by rtl_r1.py/PITFALLS/UCIE-ARC), scripts/check_site.py + site/ (wired into Makefile AND .gitlab-ci.yml jobs that run every commit), and third_party/pytorchsim (the simulator behind FINDINGS' headline numbers, absent from Dockerfile) were all untracked. Consequences: a red CI on first push (site job), unreproducible headline results, and the audit's ground truth living only in the working tree. Rule: a file is either load-bearing (commit it) or not (delete/ignore it) — 'cited but untracked' is a defect class.

CLOSE ON ARTIFACT EVIDENCE, NOT COMMIT PRESENCE. A fix commit UPDATES the seed (status in_progress + what verification is pending); CLOSE requires the artifact: a captured run on the deadlock cell with ejected==injected (or a passing test log). Corrected 2026-08-14 by Laura: Steve closed veritx-research-0344 as 'fixed by d7fce0b' on commit presence alone — but the route-table binary (vbuild_table/Vnoc_tb) never completed (only .cpp/.d intermediates), rt_test.log never captured, rtl_flits.txt = 0 lines, and F14 was still open. The tracker claimed 'fixed' while the artifact showed EXIT=127. Rule: commit presence is a hypothesis; artifact evidence is the verdict. Reopen was the correct move.

description: Subagent/ponytail-audit findings are triage, not verdicts: verify the top claims before acting.
resolution: diff over hash; inspect grep matches; spot-check top 5 claims of any audit
